tools.name: category_repos
tools.description: The repos of one category, ranked by total stars or by stars gained in the last 30 days, with archived repos last. Repos awesome-go lists come first; classified marks repos a classifier added.

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: One repo: total stars, rank among all tracked Go repos, stars gained in the last 7 days, 30 days, and 12 months, topics, archived state, and last push.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories of Go repos: the libraries categories of awesome-go, such as web-frameworks, orm, and logging, and app categories such as ai-agents, mcp-servers, and kubernetes-and-containers, with repo counts and stars gained in the last 30 days.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: GitHub topics, tags repo authors set, that at least 10 tracked Go repos carry, most repos first. Categories (list_categories) are the curated groups; topics narrow them down.

tools.name: owner_repos
tools.description: Every tracked Go repo of one GitHub user or organization, most stars first, with their totals.

tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Search Go repositories by words, best match first. Popular repos rank higher among equal matches.

tools.name: star_history
tools.description: The stars one repo gained in each week, month, or year since it was created, oldest first.

tools.name: topic_repos
tools.description: The Go repos with one GitHub topic, a tag repo authors set, ranked by stars gained in the last 30 days and by total stars, with related topics. For curated groups, use category_repos.

tools.name: trending_repos
tools.description: The 10 Go repos that gained the most stars yesterday, in the last 7 days, or in the last 30 days, or the 10 with the most stars of all time.
